name: Neon Pulse Distortion
description: Blackbody plasma cell array: each cell owns a spectrum band that sets its temperature and flicker, heat conducts between neighbouring cells, and hot neighbours strike jittering filament arcs. Temperature persists with T^4 radiative cooling; the cursor heats cells, clicks send thermal shock fronts.

params.name: Grid Density
params.description: Number of plasma cells across the frame (maps to zoom_params.x).

params.name: Base Temperature
params.description: Cell base temperature in Kelvin, 800-12000 K (maps to zoom_params.y).

params.name: Audio Heat Gain
params.description: How much spectrum energy adds to cell temperature (maps to zoom_params.z).

params.name: Glow Width
params.description: Gaussian hotspot sigma; hotter cells glow wider (maps to zoom_params.w).
